summary: In December 2014, one person was arrested in South East, Delhi for the aggravated penetrative assault on a child. The charges also include kidnapping and criminal intimidation. A weapon was used or a threat was made. Police have filed a chargesheet. The accused was convicted and sentenced to 15 years in prison. An appeal against the verdict has been filed. Identifying details are withheld by law (POCSO s.23).
title: Aggravated penetrative assault on a child — South East (2014) — convicted, 15 years
